boxes.name: Entries
interface: add(entry: NewEntry) → EntryId?  // records one entry; nothing when it is already there
search(filter: Filter) → [Entry]  // finds entries by date, category or text
Entry = { id: EntryId, date: Date, amount: Money, payee: Text, category: CategoryId? }  // one expense or income
NewEntry = { date: Date, amount: Money, payee: Text }  // an entry not yet recorded
Filter = { from: Date?, to: Date?, category: CategoryId?, text: Text? }  // which entries to find

boxes.name: Categories
boxes.line: rules that sort an entry into a category
interface: categorize(entry: NewEntry) → CategoryId?  // applies the first rule that matches

boxes.name: Budgets
boxes.line: monthly limits and what is left
interface: left(month: Month) → [BudgetLine]  // says what is left of each limit
BudgetLine = { category: CategoryId, limit: Money, spent: Money }  // one limit and how much of it is used

boxes.name: Reports
interface: monthly(month: Month) → Report  // totals one month by category

boxes.name: Store
interface: write(change: Change)  // applies one change, all of it or none

boxes.name: Shared
interface: Money = { cents: Int }  // an amount, in the home currency
Month = { year: Int, month: Int }  // one calendar month
